dedupe_keys.name: global land use and land cover from 2020 to 2100 at 1 km under ssp rcp scenarios plus model zhang cheng wu 2023

description: This dataset gives global land use and land cover at 1 km for 2020 to 2100 under representative SSP-RCP scenarios. Tianyuan Zhang, Changxiu Cheng and Xudong Wu of Beijing Normal University and the National Tibetan Plateau Data Center published it with a data descriptor in Scientific Data in October 2023. Land suitability probabilities are differentiated for historical and future periods from climatic and socioeconomic factors, and an improved cellular automata model, PLUS, downscales river-basin land demands to patches at 1 km, feeding each simulated year into the next; the authors report Kappa 0.94, overall accuracy 0.97 and figure of merit 0.10. Coverage is global. Format and access: single-band GeoTIFF files in world Mercator, named by scenario and year, on figshare. Licence: not stated on the pages read; the article is open access; free. Caveats: accuracy is measured on historical periods, and the scenario set is a subset of SSP-RCP combinations. It supports long-range exposure and green-blue planning studies. Related catalogue records are the Chen, Li and Liu 1 km SSP-RCP land projections and the China 1 km FLUS projections.
